entries.source:
You never thought this could even exist. You certainly never thought you'd encounter it. But this is true, in front of you stands a piece of Amakthel himself.
The god that myths say was slain by the Sher'tul, themselves nothing but a myth.
But there it is, half alive, half dead but you can feel his thoughts in your head, there is no mistake: #{bold}#The Dead God is here!#{normal}#
entries.target:
你从没想过这种东西竟然真的存在，更没想过自己会遇到它。但这是真的，矗立在你面前的正是阿马克泰尔本体的一部分。
神话说，这位神被夏·图尔人杀死，而夏·图尔人本身也不过是个神话。
但他就在这里，半生半死，而你能在脑海中感受到他的思维，没有错：#{bold}#已死之神就在这里！#{normal}#

entries.source: When worn, gives you an additional prodigy point.
entries.target: 装备时，获得一点觉醒点。

entries.source: #GOLD#The light of the Amulet envelops you, then subsides. You feel stronger. (+1 Prodigy Points)
entries.target: #GOLD#项链的光芒笼罩了你，随后渐渐消退。你感觉更加强大了。（+1觉醒点）

entries.source: #GOLD#The light of the Amulet envelops you, then subsides. You feel stronger. (+1 Prodigy Points)
entries.target: #GOLD#项链的光芒笼罩了你，随后渐渐消退。你感觉更加强大了。（+1觉醒点）

entries.source: The end of the staircase was trapped, you fell for a long time, luckily not breaking anything. But you have no way back now...
entries.target: 楼梯尽头设有陷阱，你坠落了很久，幸好没摔断哪里。但你现在已经无路可回了……

entries.source: You wonder how this yeti can have wandered so far from its native habitat in the Clork Peninsula. You also wonder what happened to it that produced the celestial energies-wielding creature you angrily marching towards you.
entries.target: 你不禁好奇，这只雪人怎么会离开克拉克半岛的原生栖息地，游荡到如此遥远的地方。你还想知道，它究竟经历了什么，才变成眼前这个驾驭天体能量、正愤怒地向你走来的生物。

entries.source: This warrior's armor glows with a bright golden light. He wields an ornate sword and shield, and marches towards you with confidence.
entries.target: 这位战士的盔甲闪耀着璀璨的金光。他挥动华丽的剑与盾，自信地向你冲来。

entries.source: A stern-looking orc, armed to the teeth.
entries.target: 一个严肃的兽人，武装到牙齿。

entries.source: A nasty looking orc armed with double steamguns.
entries.target: 一个面目凶恶的兽人，手持两把蒸汽枪。

entries.source: An %s has managed to join forces with you!
An ancient archive of knowledge! It seems to have some kind of vocal interface.
entries.target: 一份远古知识的宝库！它似乎能和你对话。

entries.source: You are not coward enough to leave your home unprotected!
entries.target: 你不是那种不顾家园安危只顾自己死活的懦夫！

entries.source: A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.
entries.target: 一名严肃的守卫，他不会允许任何人打扰镇子的宁静。

entries.source: A nasty looking orc armed with double steamguns.
entries.target: 一个面目凶恶的兽人，手持两把蒸汽枪。

entries.source: This heavily armored steam giant carries a huge battleaxe, swinging it menacingly towards you.
entries.target: 这个身披重甲的蒸汽巨人手持一柄巨大的战斧，正恶狠狠地朝你挥舞。

entries.source: This big undead minotaur is carrying a nasty looking hammer, imbued with lightning.
entries.target: 这个巨大的亡灵米诺陶拿着一把灌注了闪电的可怕巨锤。

entries.source: This device seems to be designed to 'hack' the mind of a wild yeti to make it able to be used as a weapon of war.
entries.target: 该装置似乎是为了“侵入”荒野雪人的心智而设计的，以便将其用作战争武器。

entries.source: The legendary Wyrm seems to have fallen, though it doesn't appear to have stuck.
entries.target: 这条传奇巨龙似乎已经陨落，可它看来并未真的死去。
